name: Drua Sailing Experience
subtitle: Serviceable 24 V solar workshop with two independently breakered battery strings

currency.note: Planning rate retained from the source workbook; use the actual purchase-date rate.

budget.note: Panels, batteries, the UniFi Express, three QHLightlux fixtures, the Amazon Victron order and all additional Amazon electrical/accessory orders through 21 Aug 2026 are included in the project total as purchased. A 20% deposit has also been paid toward the MultiPlus-II, which will be supplied in Fiji; its $939 row remains a USD planning value until the Fiji invoice total and deposit amount are entered. The estimated $607.11 Ekrano GX increment remains donor-funded pending the final border-cost reconciliation. Two QHLightlux fixtures are installed and the third is a carried spare. The purchased Orion 24/12-30A and portable Starlink power leads are carried accessories rather than installed loads. Seven Amazon receipts are reconciled through separate promotion, supplier-shipping and U.S.-sales-tax adjustment rows. Freight beyond Nadi, panel mounting, Starlink hardware and labor are excluded.

summary: Four 565 W panels form two matched two-panel series strings (2S2P) and feed a Victron SmartSolar 150/85 through two separate 4 mm² positive/negative home runs. The purchased indoor 2-in/1-out PV entry box combines the strings through a two-pole disconnect and surge protection; its supplied 32 A string fuses must be replaced with correctly listed 20 A gPV links before commissioning because the Suntech module maximum series-fuse rating is 25 A. Four 12 V GEL batteries form two 24 V series strings. Each positive leaves its string through a purchased non-polarized MidNite Solar MNEPV125-80-1PNP 125 A / 80 VDC breaker in a compact finger-safe enclosure, then lands independently on the covered main positive bus. The two breakers provide string isolation and whole-bank shutdown, so no battery selector or additional master switch is fitted. Both breakers remain ON during normal service. A non-GX Victron MultiPlus-II provides AC and generator charging, while the Ekrano GX coordinates charge current, local monitoring and VRM reporting. The battery-bus-fed SmartSolar and service-feeder circuits retain high-interrupt MidNite DC breakers; lower-current downstream services use polarized CHTAIXI B-curve breakers after the MidNite feeder. Starlink uses its single OEM 15 m white DC lead. UniFi, a six-port Scanstrut USB-C/A charging panel and two identical warm-white utility lights use protected nominal-24 V branches.

powerModel.assumptions: 4.2 peak-sun-hours, 75% solar derate, 50% GEL depth of discharge, one power tool at a time, about 0.10 kWh/day for the always-on Ekrano GX with its display normally asleep, and 15 m one-way copper PV runs. PV cable loss uses 0.01724 Ω·mm²/m copper resistivity at 20°C; field temperature raises resistance, so confirm the actual route and cable before purchase.

batteryCablePlan.conductor: 1/0 AWG (53.5 mm²) UL 1426 flexible tinned-copper marine battery cable
batteryCablePlan.procurement: Import factory-crimped, adhesive-heat-shrunk assemblies; no heavy-cable crimper is required on site.
batteryCablePlan.measurementRule: Buy only after a 1:1 layout using the two received MidNite breakers and their enclosure. Measure along the supported route, preserve broad bend radii, keep the paired A/B paths equal, and confirm every battery, breaker, busbar and MultiPlus termination before ordering. The breaker is specified for 14 AWG through 1/0 AWG conductors; match the factory-prepared breaker end to the terminal geometry and instructions on the received product.

assemblies.lugs: M8 ring at battery; factory-prepared breaker end to match received terminal

components.title: PV protection + combine
components.kicker: Single indoor building-entry unit · PV-rated DC
components.summary: Both complete string pairs enter one indoor enclosure, where protected terminals parallel them ahead of surge protection and a common disconnect.
specs: 2 complete string-pair inputs · four labeled conductors
Type 2 PV SPD coordinated with 150 V MPPT
2 × 20 A 10×38 mm gPV string links · replace supplied 32 A links
60 m single-core cable total at 15 m one-way
components.note: The purchased CXCESNS B0FSQB97T2 is a true 2-input/1-output indoor combiner, but its supplied 32 A string links exceed Suntech's published 25 A maximum series-fuse rating. Replace them with correctly listed 20 A 10×38 mm gPV links and carry two matching spares before energizing the array. Confirm the exact module labels, cable ampacity, connector ratings and applicable Fiji/AS-NZS requirements. Each string can sit near 105 VDC in cool sunlight: cover modules before connector work and never break MC4 connectors under load.

components.title: SmartSolar MPPT 150/85-Tr
components.summary: A separate Victron charger keeps solar charging and essential DC services independent of the AC inverter/charger.
specs: 150 V absolute maximum PV Voc · 145 V operating maximum
2,400 W nominal PV capacity at 24 V
components.note: The 2S strings model at 104.7 V cold Voc, leaving about 40 V below the 145 V operating ceiling. Mount the controller terminals-down in the dry indoor alcove within 3 m of the battery bus and use a MidNite Solar MNEDC100 100 A / 150 VDC / 10 kA AIC resettable output breaker with 10 cm ventilation clearance. After each clean terminal is correctly crimped and torqued, apply only a thin exterior moisture-barrier film of dielectric grease around the completed connection; never place grease between the current-carrying clamping faces or use it as a substitute for touch-safe, dry mounting. Set the charger itself to 85 A maximum and let Ekrano DVCC cap the combined system charge current. Its VE.Can, remote on/off and programmable-relay interfaces remain available but unused in the base design.

components.title: MultiPlus-II 24/3000
components.summary: The non-GX model provides the same inverter, generator charger and transfer-switch capability while leaving the Ekrano GX as the system's single monitoring and control device.
specs: Supplied isolated temperature sensor to battery negative
components.note: Do not substitute the MultiPlus-II GX version when installing the Ekrano. IP22 and 95% non-condensing are not salt-spray ratings: mount in the dry, ventilated inner room behind the drip/salt shield, away from sea-facing openings and batteries. AC-out-2, remote on/off, programmable relay, auxiliary inputs, direct voltage-sense input and external-current-sensor input remain available but unused in this base design.

components.title: Ekrano GX
components.summary: The system's only GX device combines a bright local touchscreen with coordinated DVCC control, collects inverter, solar and battery data, and sends monitoring and alarms to Victron VRM through the UniFi Express and Starlink.
specs: 2 digital inputs used by balancer alarms
DVCC · SVS/SCS from SmartShunt · STS from MultiPlus sensor
Front IP54 with steel bracket · rear IP21
components.note: Power directly from the protected 24 V bus on the system side of the SmartShunt—not from AC output or the low-voltage-controlled load branch—so it can report faults and recovery. Mount horizontally on the wall immediately above the junction box with the supplied steel bracket, sheltered from drips and salt air, and route all small leads around rather than across its front. Hardwire Ethernet to the UniFi LAN port. A separate Smart Battery Sense is intentionally omitted: Ekrano distributes the SmartShunt's measured battery voltage and current and the MultiPlus sensor's battery temperature to the SmartSolar through DVCC. The two native temperature inputs and two relays remain available for future sensors or an alarm buzzer.

components.title: 24 V · 400 Ah GEL bank
components.kicker: Two independently breakered 2S strings · normally paralleled
components.summary: 9.6 kWh nominal, operated to about 50% depth of discharge for longer GEL life.
specs: One string: 4.8 kWh nominal · 2.4 kWh usable
components.note: Fully charge and voltage-match all four units separately before assembly. Use equal-length positive and negative string leads, and keep both 125 A breakers ON during normal service so both strings charge and discharge together. For a suspected fault, stop AC loads and charging, switch both string breakers OFF, diagnose with a meter, disconnect and insulate the failed string, then restore only the verified good string if emergency service is required.

components.title: Main DC distribution
components.summary: One covered AMOMD red/black 600 A busbar pair combines the two independently breakered string positives and collects all system negatives; all negative current crosses the SmartShunt.
specs: 2 × purchased MidNite MNEPV125-80-1PNP 125 A string breakers
Positive bus · 8 conductors across 12 separate positions
Negative bus · 6 conductors across 12 separate positions
AMOMD pair · each bar has four M10 studs + eight M4 screws
SmartShunt IP65 500 A · supplied 1 A fused Vbatt+ lead
components.note: Mount the two battery-string breakers in their own finger-safe enclosure close to the batteries. Each breaker output gets its own main-positive-bus landing; do not combine the strings on a breaker terminal and do not use the enclosure's small accessory busbars for battery current. Both equal-length string negatives land on SmartShunt BATTERY MINUS. Nothing else connects on the BATTERY MINUS side. The positive bar uses eight of twelve positions and the negative bar uses six of twelve, so no circuit lugs need to share a terminal.

components.title: Dual battery-string breaker enclosure
components.summary: Two separately purchased resettable breakers protect and isolate the two 24 V battery strings before their positive conductors join at the main bus.
specs: Both handles ON in normal operation
components.note: These two breakers replace both Class T fuse assemblies and the Blue Sea battery switch. Switch both OFF before servicing the main DC box; isolate a single string only after all loads and charging are stopped. Verify received terminal geometry, conductor preparation, enclosure fit and bend radius with a 1:1 mock-up.

components.title: String A 125 A breaker
components.summary: Resettable 80 VDC protection and isolation for battery string A before it reaches the main positive bus.

components.title: String B 125 A breaker
components.summary: Resettable 80 VDC protection and isolation for battery string B before it reaches the main positive bus.

components.title: Main positive bus
components.summary: Each 125 A battery-string breaker lands on a separate high-current position; protected feeds then leave for the MultiPlus, SmartSolar, services, Starlink and Ekrano/sense circuits.
components.note: High-current landings are breaker A, breaker B, MultiPlus and SmartSolar. Small positions serve the service feeder, Starlink, Ekrano and SmartShunt Vbatt+ sense lead. No lug doubling is required.

components.title: Victron SmartShunt IP65 500 A
components.summary: Both battery-string negatives land on BATTERY MINUS; one short 1/0 AWG link from SYSTEM MINUS feeds the negative bus, so every charging and load ampere is measured.
components.note: Nothing except the two battery-string negatives connects on the BATTERY MINUS side. All chargers, loads and chassis-related DC returns connect on the SYSTEM MINUS side through the negative bus. The purchased Amazon unit is the IP65 version; confirm its exact part number and serial from the product label before completing the customs manifest.

components.title: Main negative bus
components.summary: This covered bus collects every charger and load return after current has crossed the SmartShunt.
components.note: The only connection from this bus toward the batteries is the short SYSTEM MINUS link through the SmartShunt. Never bypass the shunt with a direct battery-negative return.

components.title: Low-current service return bus
components.summary: This junction-box bus collects the five low-current load returns and one main-negative feeder; Starlink returns directly to the main negative bus.
components.note: One ring terminal lands on each position. Do not double small screw terminals merely to create room; this bar already has the required capacity.

Resettable small-current breaker on each positive sense lead where the balancer manual permits; otherwise retain the specified inline fuse
Alarm relay from each unit to one Ekrano digital input

AC input-current limit commissioned to the generator, plug and cable rating

Verify the actual generator before buying the plug. Never make a male-to-male lead. The generator's own breaker may provide input-cable protection only when its rating does not exceed the selected cable and plug ampacity.

components.title: AC output protection
components.summary: Small plywood-mounted enclosure with a two-pole 10 A / 30 mA Type A RCBO feeding one flexible tool lead; no receptacle is fixed to the building wall.

components.title: Trailing tool lead

components.title: 24 V breaker distribution
components.summary: A MidNite 100 A SmartSolar breaker and MidNite 20 A high-interrupt service feeder protect the two battery-bus-fed circuits; five lower-cost CHTAIXI breakers protect the downstream positive branches. Black load conductors return unswitched and unbroken to the negative bus.
specs: MidNite MNEDC100 · 100 A SmartSolar output · 10 kA
MidNite MNEPV20 · 20 A service feeder · 10 kA
CHTAIXI B15 · 15 A six-port USB panel
2 × CHTAIXI B6 · 6 A indoor / outdoor lights
Six-breaker service bank · 3 inputs / 6 protected outputs
CHTAIXI branches are polarized · observe marked line/load direction
Blue Sea 2314 return bus · 6 used landings + 1 spare
components.note: The six-breaker service bank has three incoming positive conductors and six outgoing protected conductors. The retained MidNite 20 A service feeder and 6 A Starlink breaker each have an independent input and output; one short common-input comb supplies the adjacent UniFi, USB, inside-light and outside-light CHTAIXI breakers. Only positives pass through breakers and switches. The CHTAIXI devices are allowed only downstream of the 10 kA MidNite feeder, must be wired in their marked DC polarity, and require installer verification of series coordination and Fiji acceptance.

components.title: SmartSolar 100 A DC breaker
components.summary: The dedicated high-interrupt breaker protects and isolates the SmartSolar battery-positive conductor between the main positive bus and MPPT gland.
components.note: This is the large MPPT branch breaker shown separately from the six-breaker low-current service bank. Its two selectable cylindrical ports are the positive-bus input and SmartSolar output.

components.title: Ekrano GX 3.15 A fuse
components.summary: The small inline holder protects the always-on Ekrano GX positive supply so monitoring remains available while other loads are switched off.
specs: Supplied or specified with Ekrano GX power lead
Individually selectable input and output ports
components.note: This remains a fuse because it is part of Victron's specified low-current equipment lead; carry labeled spares with the system.

components.title: Essential low-voltage services
components.kicker: All services on nominal 24 V branches
components.summary: Starlink Mini and UniFi share one exterior master switch while remaining on separately breakered 24 V poles; indoor and outdoor lights have separate source-side switches; general USB charging remains unswitched.
components.note: Starlink hardware itself is outside the project purchase scope.

components.title: Starlink Mini
components.summary: Primary continuous load, supplied at nominal 24 V through one breakered and switched branch and the single OEM 15 m white DC power cable used in the PG approach.
specs: 6 A CHTAIXI B-curve DC breaker at nominal 24 V
One 15 m male-to-male OEM DC cable
components.note: Use the complete unspliced Starlink cable from the junction-box bulkhead jack to the Mini. At 24 V its current and voltage drop are roughly half the 12 V case, which is materially better for the long run and startup margin.

components.title: UniFi Express
components.summary: Starlink Ethernet connects directly to the WAN port; this one purchased device provides the cloud gateway, UniFi Network controller and Wi-Fi 6 coverage.
components.note: Power it from the dedicated junction-box 12–32 V-to-5 V converter on the INTERNET switch, not from the general charging station. Preconfigure it, export a backup and print recovery instructions before travel.

components.title: Dedicated UniFi power converter
components.summary: A compact protected converter inside the junction box gives UniFi Express its own 5 V supply, so the INTERNET rocker can shut down the gateway and Starlink together without disabling general USB charging.
specs: 6 A CHTAIXI B-curve breakered nominal-24 V input
Reverse-polarity, overvoltage, overcurrent, short-circuit and thermal protection
Short high-quality USB-A to USB-C lead
components.note: Mount it inside the junction box and pass only the USB-A-to-USB-C output lead through the dedicated bottom gland. Bench-test cold boot and repeated power cycling with the exact UniFi Express before travel; the listing claims ample current, but USB-A current advertisement varies between chargers.

components.title: USB charging station
components.summary: Three hardwired marine charging modules provide six reliable ports without cigarette-lighter contacts and remain available while the internet system is off.
specs: Up to 60 W per module at 24 V
One 15 A branch pair through the junction gland
Local 3 × CHTAIXI B10 resettable DC breakers
components.note: Mount all three interior-only modules in one small splash-sheltered faceplate/back box. Split the single 24 V pair locally at that panel. Scanstrut specifies conformal-coated electronics but an interior installation; keep it out of direct spray and provide strain relief.

components.title: Exterior internet + light controls
components.summary: A three-position panel passes through the fixed left sidewall of the junction box so routine controls stay accessible without opening the enclosure and without a moving door harness.
specs: INTERNET · DPST OFF–ON · separate Starlink and UniFi 24 V positives
Three embedded indicators · one shared small negative
Continuous closed-cell perimeter gasket + sealed fasteners
components.note: The double-pole internet switch keeps the separately breakered Starlink and UniFi branches electrically isolated while operating them together. Each light has one source-side positive switch and one two-core run to its fixture; there is no separate switch cable along the building. All load negatives bypass the rockers.

components.title: Warm indoor utility light
components.summary: The same five-inch utility fixture used outside is suspended from a short interior bracket with its warm lens aimed downward.
specs: 6 A CHTAIXI B-curve breaker · source-side switch
Two series silicon diodes for charge-voltage margin
components.note: Amazon primary recommendation, ASIN B0F1V59NXC. The battery bank can charge to 28.2–28.8 V, slightly above the light's stated 28 V maximum, so install two 3 A silicon rectifier diodes in series with the positive branch to retain approximately 1.2–1.6 V of margin. Suspend from a short dry interior bracket with strain relief.

components.title: Warm outdoor utility light
components.summary: A compact down-angle warm-white fixture provides useful exterior area light at roughly one eighth the price of the previous dual-color Hella recommendation.
specs: 6 A CHTAIXI B-curve breaker · source-side switch
Two series silicon diodes for charge-voltage margin
components.note: Amazon primary recommendation, ASIN B0F1V59NXC. The battery bank can charge to 28.2–28.8 V, slightly above the light's stated 28 V maximum, so install two 3 A silicon rectifier diodes in series with the positive branch. Mount under an eave, bed the cable entry, replace supplied fasteners with 316 stainless, and inspect for corrosion because IP67 does not establish salt-spray durability.

components.title: Compact junction box + wall board
components.summary: A compact 370 × 265 × 150 mm enclosure protects the SmartShunt, covered busbars, resettable service breakers and prewired low-current connections. The two 125 A battery-string breakers sit separately in their own finger-safe enclosure near the batteries. The main box is only 20 × 18 mm larger than the PG enclosure, providing a device-free bottom gland gutter and terminal-radius-aware service clearances. A sealed three-rocker control panel passes through its fixed left sidewall; the Ekrano mounts separately just above it.
specs: No battery switch or battery-string protection inside
Power electronics and Ekrano remain on wall
Fits inside either iM2875 with padding
components.note: Keep the MultiPlus, SmartSolar, Ekrano, both balancers and the separate finger-safe battery-breaker enclosure outside this sealed box. All 14 cable glands plus the Starlink bulkhead jack are on the bottom. Each UniFi, USB and light pair enters one gland and separates only inside. Mount the 86.4 × 58.4 mm 8259 frame through the otherwise unused left sidewall, with the three switch positions stacked vertically; gasket the frame perimeter and seal its fasteners. Use factory-prepared tinned cable ends, adhesive heat-shrink, noncorroding hardware and bottom cable entries; prove component depth, terminal access, route length and the 14.4 mm cable bend envelope at 1:1 scale before ordering cables or drilling the purchased enclosure.

operatingRules: Keep both PV strings on their separate 4 mm² positive/negative home runs all the way to the indoor entry enclosure. Do not combine at the array or substitute MC4 branch leads; this revision deliberately removes the one-run fallback and the outdoor combiner.

Use one corded power tool at a time from the dedicated trailing socket and keep the tool nameplate at or below about 1,800 W. Fully uncoil and inspect the lead before use; do not add a power board, daisy-chain another extension, or combine the saw with the planer, jigsaw, drill, kettle or another large AC load. Hang the lead dry beside the equipment after use.
Run tool work mainly in sunny hours. Stop tool loads around 50% state of charge; reserve the lower half of the GEL bank for longevity and essentials.

Keep the AC inverter off when no AC loads are required. Use the exterior INTERNET rocker to shut down both Starlink and UniFi overnight; general USB charging remains available. INSIDE and OUTSIDE rockers control their light branches independently.
Leave the Ekrano GX powered so it can retain battery history and report alarms. Let its display time out when not in use; investigate alarms locally before resetting them.
Keep both 125 A battery-string breakers ON in normal service. Switch both OFF only after AC loads, MultiPlus, PV and generator charging are shut down; together they provide whole-bank isolation.

If a battery or balancer alarm suggests a bad string: shut down every load and charge source, switch both string breakers OFF, verify individual battery and string voltages with a multimeter, and disconnect and insulate both leads of the diagnosed bad string. Only then may the healthy string's breaker be returned ON. Reduce the Ekrano DVCC charge-current limit from 100 A to 50 A. A single healthy 200 Ah string can still operate one ordinary power tool, but runtime and surge headroom are roughly halved: work in sun, monitor voltage and temperature, and stop immediately on excessive sag, alarm or breaker trip.
Never equalize GEL batteries. Inspect individual battery voltage, temperature, swelling, torque and corrosion monthly.

Keep all power electronics dry and away from direct salt air. Every three months, isolate the system, inspect for salt deposits or corrosion, clean/replace the alcove filter and correct any moisture source.
Treat the generator as tested backup only. Confirm the MultiPlus accepts its voltage/frequency and verify RCD/earth behavior before relying on charging or bypass.
commissioning: Confirm all four panel and battery nameplates before terminating anything.

Before ordering the imported heavy-cable set, receive and bench-check both MidNite 125 A breakers and their finger-safe enclosure, SmartShunt and AMOMD B0DG4WLVT7 covered busbar pair; then make a full-size battery/box/MultiPlus layout from actual hardware and battery dimensions. Confirm the EverExceed terminal is M8, measure each supported route hole-to-hole, preserve broad bends, and keep the paired A/B positive and negative paths equal. Confirm the breaker terminal preparation from the received instructions and land each protected positive output on its own M10 busbar stud. Order the 11 UL 1426 tinned-copper 1/0 AWG assemblies factory-prepared with tinned terminations and adhesive heat-shrink; no site heavy-cable crimping is planned.
Separately fully charge and voltage-match the four batteries. Build two matched 24 V strings, install one balancer per string, and land each balancer alarm relay on its own Ekrano digital input.

Fit one 125 A MidNite breaker close to each string positive in the separate finger-safe enclosure. Keep both breakers ON in normal operation, use both OFF for whole-bank isolation, and land the two protected outputs separately on the main positive bus. A faulted string may be isolated only after all loads and charging are stopped and the bank is diagnosed with a multimeter.

With modules covered, build two independent two-panel series strings. Uncover and measure about 100.8 V Voc at 25°C on each string separately; confirm close agreement, polarity, labels and isolation before landing all four 4 mm² home-run conductors. Parallel them only at the protected indoor building-entry terminals, then confirm the SmartSolar's 100 A protected battery branch before closing the 40 A PV disconnect.

Before energizing the purchased combiner, remove its supplied 32 A string links and install two correctly listed 20 A 10×38 mm gPV links; carry two identical spares. Confirm the installed modules retain the published 25 A maximum series-fuse rating and 14.20 A Isc, verify each home-run cable and connector against the actual installation method and temperature, and have the final design checked against applicable Fiji/AS-NZS requirements. Record current from each string independently at commissioning.

Program MultiPlus and SmartSolar for the exact GEL label; planning values are 28.2 V absorption, 27.2 V float and equalization disabled. Install the temperature sensor supplied with the 24 V MultiPlus on Battery 1's negative terminal. In Ekrano DVCC, select the SmartShunt for Shared Voltage Sense and Shared Current Sense, select the MultiPlus sensor for Shared Temperature Sense, and set the system-wide charge-current limit to 100 A with both strings healthy. Do not add a Smart Battery Sense unless this wired sensing path is later removed or proves unusable.
Set the MultiPlus to 230 V / 50 Hz with a 10 A AC input-current limit for the G3200P; verify generator acceptance before enabling unattended charging.

With the 24 V bank isolated, make a full-size enclosure and wall-layout mock-up. Mount the Ekrano horizontally just above the approximately 14.6 × 10.4 inch junction box using its steel bracket, keep its rear and lower connectors sheltered, bond its protective-earth terminal and preserve clear service access around its face.

Power the Ekrano directly from the protected 24 V bus with its supplied 3.15 A slow-blow fused lead, with negative on the system side of the SmartShunt. Never power it from MultiPlus AC-out or from the voltage-controlled DC-load branch.

Connect the MultiPlus by Victron RJ45 UTP/VE.Bus, SmartSolar and SmartShunt by separate VE.Direct cables, both balancer alarm relays to separate Ekrano digital inputs, and Ekrano Ethernet to the UniFi Express LAN port. Confirm all three Victron devices, SmartShunt battery state, battery temperature, SVS/SCS/STS sources and both balancer alarms appear locally.

Register the Ekrano in VRM over UniFi/Starlink, enable HTTPS and two-factor authentication on administrator accounts, configure useful battery/temperature/offline alarms, set a connection-appropriate log interval, and test both local operation without internet and remote recovery after reconnect.
Set the Ekrano display auto-off timer and adaptive brightness, record the VRM Portal ID and access recovery details off-site, and export configuration backups before departure.
Torque to each manufacturer specification; re-torque after the first week and mark fasteners with witness paint.

Have a qualified electrical person test RCBO trip time, polarity, the continuous protective-earth path, lead strain relief, trailing-socket wiring and neutral-earth behavior in both inverter and generator/bypass modes. There are no fixed workshop wall outlets.

Cut the Blue Sea 8259 opening in the fixed junction-box sidewall only after a 1:1 fit check. Install the 8287 DPST rocker as INTERNET and two 8282 SPST rockers as INSIDE and OUTSIDE; add a continuous closed-cell perimeter gasket, seal every fastener, insulate the rear terminals and leave the hinged door free of control wiring.

Install the resettable DC breaker map exactly as documented: MidNite MNEDC100 SmartSolar and MNEPV20 service feeder; downstream CHTAIXI B6 Starlink, B6 UniFi, B15 USB panel and 2 × B6 lights. Feed Starlink from its 6 A breaker into INTERNET pole A and return it to the main negative bus; INTERNET pole B switches UniFi, and the two SPST rockers switch only their light positives. Wire every CHTAIXI DC breaker in its marked polarity, use conductors rated for the selected breaker and have the qualified installer verify series coordination and Fiji acceptance.

Connect Starlink Ethernet directly to the UniFi Express WAN port. Feed UniFi directly from the 24 V bank through the dedicated junction-box 12–32 V-to-5 V converter on INTERNET switch pole B, export a UniFi backup, and bench-test at least ten cold starts and simultaneous Starlink/UniFi shutdowns before travel. Confirm general USB charging stays live with INTERNET off.

Build the six-port charging station from one Scanstrut SC-TILE-20 and two SC-TILE-10 modules in one dry interior faceplate/back box. Feed one 15 A protected 24 V pair from the junction box, split it locally through three CHTAIXI B10 resettable 10 A DC breakers, label the four USB-C and two USB-A ports, and load-test all modules simultaneously before travel.

Use QHLightlux B0F1V59NXC 3000 K fixtures for both locations. Suspend the indoor unit from a short dry bracket with its lens down; mount the outdoor unit under an eave with 316 stainless fasteners and sealed bedding. Put two 3 A silicon rectifier diodes in series with each switched positive branch so the fixture stays below its 28 V input ceiling during GEL absorption. Heat-shrink and support the diode packs, verify polarity and voltage drop, and use one site-measured two-core marine cable to each fixture.

Bench-test the Starlink Mini from the 24 V branch through its complete OEM 15 m cable: verify center-positive polarity at the bulkhead jack, cold-start it at low battery voltage, and confirm INTERNET simultaneously removes Starlink and UniFi 24 V feeds without interrupting USB or lights.

Run the 1,800 W saw alone for 30 minutes in warm conditions with the 5 m lead fully uncoiled while monitoring inverter, lead, plug/socket, cable and terminal temperature; post the one-page operating rules and breaker map beside the equipment.
